items.title: 61125_Teddy Bunn oral history interview
items.q: I didn't come out here with Ethel. I was back east with Ethel.

ctx.x: Because they had movie studios back here for awhile, you know, in New Jersey, I think, in the '20s and the early '30s.
Wow. I didn't come out here with Ethel. I was back east with Ethel.
